name: Four Seasons Kuala Lumpur
insider_take: This sky-high sanctuary floats above the golden triangle, where Malaysian royalty and tech moguls retreat to towers that pierce the clouds.
whats_special: Perched on floors 65-84 of the Petronas Twin Towers complex, this is one of the world's highest urban hotels. The spa features traditional Malay healing rituals using indigenous ingredients, while the infinity pool offers unobstructed views of the iconic towers that once defined the world's tallest building crown.
pro_tip: Book the Premier Twin Towers View room for direct sightlines to the skybridge connection. The towers' LED light show happens nightly at 8 PM and 9 PM - visible from your window without the street-level crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive access to KLCC Park's jogging track at sunrise, and Yun House's dim sum service featuring durian-infused desserts that showcase Malaysia's controversial "king of fruits" in an approachable luxury format.
pros: Prime location in KLCC with direct Petronas Towers views
cons: Busy urban location in financial district
